title: Salesforce Decision Facilitator Inputs
description: Typed inputs for one evidence-based Salesforce decision analysis.

decision_question.description: One bounded Salesforce decision question that the run must answer.

desired_outcome.description: Measurable business or engineering outcome used to evaluate options.

constraints.description: Hard constraints, preferences, and non-goals; hard constraints must be distinguishable.

known_options.description: Optional starting options; the agent still checks standard, reuse, experiment, and no-change alternatives.

target_context.description: Optional org, project, release, workload, data-volume, package, and authority context.

evidence.description: Optional source, org, project, test, cost, or policy evidence supplied to the run.

criteria_weights.description: Optional named criterion weights whose numeric values must total 100.

decision_deadline.description: Optional ISO date or named milestone by which the decision is needed.

stopping_point.description: Requested terminal artifact for the run.

source_boundary.description: Controls whether analysis is bounded to supplied sources or may use official/open research.

target_org_alias.description: Optional authenticated org alias when org-specific evidence is material.
